reason: A LAN-access plugin for the DeepSeek harness web GUI that adds password-gated remote access, mobile-oriented interface adaptation, firewall handling, and synchronized multi-browser sessions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek harness Web GUI 提供带口令的局域网访问、移动端触控适配和多浏览器状态同步。
summaries.en: Provides password-gated LAN access to the DeepSeek harness web GUI with mobile touch adaptation and synchronized state across browsers.

capabilities: Binds the web GUI to all network interfaces for LAN access
Adds a password login gate for LAN browsers
Modifies host firewall rules to allow the service port
Injects mobile touch and portrait-layout adaptations into the official interface
Exposes selected privileged operations through a password-protected LAN API path
Synchronizes sessions and events across connected browser clients
